name: Article 2 – after paragraph 1 – 424
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on circularity requirements for vehicle design and on management of end-of-life vehicles, amending Regulations (EU) 2018/858 and 2019/1020 and repealing Directives 2000/53/EC and 2005/64/EC
part_text: (1a) This Regulation shall apply to the vehicle categories specified in Annex I from the date of application. It shall exclude vehicles of historical interest and those kept for restoration, collection, museum or cultural purposes, as well as spare parts, assemblies and components intended for the preservation, repair or restoration of such vehicles. Simplified certification and reporting obligations and appropriate transition periods shall apply to micro-, small and medium-sized enterprises and small volume manufacturers.
